transcript.text: Last spring when I was in Shanghai, I remember we kept joking that the whole trip revolved around eating.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Earlier in that same stretch, my coworker had flown from Beijing to Shanghai for a meeting, and I tagged along for part of it.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And then later we did a separate little getaway in Hangzhou—mostly just to slow down for a couple days.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: One night in Shanghai we ended up at Xiao Nan Guo, and the table was under Zhou Jun with that phone number 13813897597.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I still remember the dinner details because it was so hectic: it was on 2025-04-29 at 19:00, and there were 4 of us squeezed in.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For the flight piece, the ticket my colleague already had was MU5678 on China Eastern, dated 2025-05-03.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Everything was under Xie Peng back then—both that flight booking and the Hangzhou stay at West Lake State Guesthouse, checking in 2025-05-12 for 3 nights.
